results.question: in 2025, which month saw the biggest increase in completed deals over the month before?
results.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    c.year,
    c.month,
    c.month_name,
    COUNT(*) AS completed_deals
  FROM nlq.deals d
  JOIN nlq.calendar c ON c.day = d.completed_on
  WHERE d.status = 'completed'
    AND c.year = 2025
  GROUP BY c.year, c.month, c.month_name
)
SELECT 
  m1.month_name AS month,
  m1.completed_deals,
  (m1.completed_deals - m2.completed_deals) AS delta,
  round(( (m1.completed_deals - m2.completed_deals)::numeric / m2.completed_deals ) * 100, 2) AS pct_increase
FROM monthly m1
LEFT JOIN monthly m2
  ON m2.month = m1.month - 1
WHERE m2.month IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 1;
